legal.title: Before you start
legal.intro: TAMGA is an experimental Linux package conversion tool. Please read these few points.
legal.p1: Use at your own risk: a converted package may not work correctly or, in rare cases, may conflict with your system. Back up your important data before installing a converted package.
legal.p2: No warranty: TAMGA is provided “as is”, under its MIT license. The authors cannot be held liable for damage to your system, data or software.
legal.p3: Suggested dependencies are estimated matches, sometimes taken from public databases (distribution repositories, Repology): always check before installing.
legal.p4: It is your responsibility to make sure you are allowed to redistribute or modify a package you convert.
legal.p5: Linux, Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Red Hat, Arch Linux, openSUSE and the other names mentioned belong to their respective owners. TAMGA is an independent project.
about.title: About
about.author: Created by
about.privacy_text: No personal data, no telemetry, no ads. For online lookups, only package names are sent to Repology.
about.credits: Rust, Tauri, and the free libraries tar, flate2, xz2, zstd, goblin.
err.title: Cannot continue
err.foreign_script: This .sh script was not created by TAMGA: there is no way to know where its files go.
err.source_rpm: This is a source package (.src.rpm): it contains code to compile, not a ready-to-install program.
err.appimage: AppImages are not supported: they already run on every distribution.
err.archive: .zip and .rar archives are not Linux packages: TAMGA does not know where to install their files.
err.unknown_format: Unrecognized format. TAMGA accepts .deb, .rpm, Arch packages, Slackware packages (.txz, .tgz…), tar archives, Stampede packages (.slp), Solaris packages (.pkg) and .sh files created by TAMGA.
err.empty_name: The package name cannot be empty.
warn.debconf: This package asks questions during installation (debconf): they will not be carried over.
warn.non_root_owner: Some files belong to a user other than root: this is preserved.
warn.arch_mismatch: The declared architecture does not match the programs inside.
warn.noarch_binaries: The package claims to be architecture-independent but contains compiled programs.
warn.ld_conf_added: The libraries are in an unusual folder for the target: TAMGA added an ld.so.conf.d file so they can be found.
warn.missing_deps: Some dependencies could not be translated.
warn.scripts_included: The original scripts are included: check that everything works after installation.
target.tar: Tar archive, to extract at the root /
install.failed: Installation failed. See the log below.
deps.generic_note: This format does not declare dependencies: the list shows the libraries the programs need; install them yourself if they are missing.
err.install_not_here: This format cannot be installed directly on this system. Use the command shown on a compatible distribution.
err.no_pkexec: Cannot ask for the administrator password (pkexec is missing). Use the command shown in a terminal.
err.install_cancelled: Installation cancelled: the password was refused or the window was closed.
err.solaris_write: TAMGA can read Solaris packages but cannot create them.
err.slp_version: This Stampede package uses a format version that is too old.
warn.solaris: Solaris package: its programs will not run on Linux. Only scripts, documents and data are usable.
warn.solaris_multi: This file contains several Solaris packages: only the first one is converted.
warn.solaris_missing: Some files listed in the Solaris package could not be found: they were skipped.
warn.tar_no_meta: Archive without package information: the name and version come from the file name. Check them before converting.
warn.tar_relocated: This archive is not laid out like a Linux system: its contents will be installed in /opt/<name>, with shortcuts in /usr/bin.
warn.tar_no_uninstall: A tar archive is installed by extracting it at the root: it cannot be uninstalled automatically.
warn.tar_no_scripts: A tar archive cannot contain installation scripts: they were not carried over.
warn.slp_arch: Stampede does not know this architecture: the package is marked “all architectures”.
